dedupe_keys.name: nowphas ナウファス nationwide ocean wave information network for ports and harbours of japan wave observation data

description: NOWPHAS is the nationwide ocean wave information network for ports and harbours of Japan, whose observations are processed and published by the Marine Information Group of the Port and Airport Research Institute. The wave data page read on 2026-09-28 explains the contents with sample data: since the Ishikari new port station of 2004, a continuous observation system analyses waves for every 20-minute unit, 72 times a day, replacing 12 two-hourly analyses, and 71 points ran on it at the end of 2014. The page offers sample time-series figures and high-wave tables as PDF, sample wave records as text files (333 KB and 2 MB continuous) and the data format description. Coverage is Japanese ports and coastal stations. Access to the samples is free; the page states no licence, and how the full archive is obtained was not read. Caveats: the page is partly dated and shows samples, so station lists and archive years must be checked with PARI. It supports hazard exposure and resilience studies of ports, such as design wave and storm wave statistics at harbour entrances. No related Japanese wave record is catalogued.
